snippet.title: Fixer Undercover - Official Trailer | Upload VR Showcase 2025
snippet.description: Get a closer look at Fixer Undercover in this trailer for the MacGyver-inspired VR puzzle adventure game. Learn about your objectives, meet your mission partner, see the tools at your disposal, and more in this Fixer Undercover trailer. In Fixer Undercover, play as an undercover agent infiltrating a prison to investigate a suspicious prisoner rehabilitation program. Use tools and create improvised solutions to complete missions. Fixer Undercover is coming soon to Steam.
